scope: Compact offscreen atlas L1 source slots using a conservative capture-sphere Frobenius bound against side planes only. Preserve legacy/readiness fallback, allocator identity and all shader/atlas/quality/LOD/fade/spin behavior.

method.hardware: Native Chrome155, AMD Radeon Graphics / ANGLE D3D11,1280x720 DPR1, Yandex S3 assets, Vite dev server
method.frozen: Stop engine; copy full canonical allocation slots as baseline and actual compact production buffers as candidate. Identical programs/frozen uniforms/borrowed textures. Compare every HDR/depth component bit. Front and2000km translation+90-degree turn in both scenes.
method.timing: Six warmup pairs then32 adjacent GPU-query pairs, alternating order; repeat whole batch. Drain after each pair. Isolated L1 draws, not whole-frame speedup.
method.motion: 64 real frames,4000km translation and360-degree turn; per-draw GPU queries in RenderPass plus CPU visibility timings with explicit frame-window guard. Separate64-frame whole-renderFrame query run. No paired baseline motion; CPU arrays copied on changed membership/source versions.

memory.note: Full production capacity100000:6.4MB matrix+2.8MB instance attributes+0.4MB slot indices. Reuses GPU buffers;9.155MiB extra CPU arrays per compared belt, once atlas compaction activates. Small object/Map overhead excluded.

Full production capacity100000:6.4MB matrix+2.8MB instance attributes+0.4MB slot indices. Reuses GPU buffers;9.155MiB extra CPU arrays per compared belt, once atlas compaction activates. Small object/Map overhead excluded.

conclusions.remaining: Item16 remains open: visible geometry, volume dust and nebula reconstruction. Single-device native measurements do not establish cross-device or whole-frame acceleration.

diagnosisInterpretation.vertexReordering: Deferring inverse/frame selection after GPU side rejection gave no useful gain.
diagnosisInterpretation.tightCompaction: Per-plane transformed-sphere support preserved all4HDR/depth comparisons and reduced GPU cost, but5.4–6.3ms stable CPU was too expensive.
diagnosisInterpretation.frobenius: One sqrt per source slot preserved all4HDR/depth comparisons with1.5–2.2ms stable prototype CPU. Production motion has additional changed-membership copies and is reported separately.
diagnosisInterpretation.prototypeMemoryCorrection: Tight prototype extraCpuBytes used original slot capacity and shorter matrix clones, so it is not production memory. Frobenius report corrects actual prototype allocation and separately predicts9,600,000 production capacity bytes; production confirmation measures those arrays directly.

finalReview.reviewedState: Staged task changes before local commit; structured evidence inspected separately from text diff.
strengths: Capture-plane square acceptance is enclosed by2*h and Frobenius under spin, anisotropic scale, reflection and shear; transformed normalized side planes account for parents.
Side-only selection preserves reconstructed/logarithmic depth; current bounds are read each update and invalid shared inputs restore full source data.
Canonical allocator slots preserve writes, release/reuse, rebasing/reset/fallback and original GPU buffer ownership; storage is lazy.
Original L0/Near selection and compact copying are preserved.
Measured isolated L1 GPU improvement is supported and additional CPU/memory costs are disclosed.
finalReview.verdict: Ready for the intended local commit as a measured L1 GPU-work optimization, with documented CPU/memory costs and limits retained.

declinedToJudge.behavior: Net whole-frame FPS or latency improvement
declinedToJudge.reason: No paired baseline whole-frame/moving run; instrumented intervals cannot prove causal throughput improvement.
declinedToJudge.ruling: Nonblocking evidence limit. Report33–52%isolated L1 GPU reduction only; retain raw unpaired motion/whole-frame observations without an FPS claim.
declinedToJudge.costIfWrong: User could expect a global speedup absent from the real workload; no such speedup is promised.

declinedToJudge.reason: Only the disclosed native device/cloud scenes measured; moving CPU p503.4/4.5ms may be material elsewhere.
declinedToJudge.ruling: Nonblocking platform/performance limit. Preserve visible quality and disclose the added CPU work; do not extrapolate benefit beyond these measurements.
declinedToJudge.costIfWrong: CPU-limited workloads may become slower despite fewer GPU submissions; further device-specific profiling remains open.

declinedToJudge.behavior: Aggregate memory across many active belts or constrained devices
declinedToJudge.reason: Per-belt full-capacity arrays verified; aggregate peak/device limits unmeasured.
declinedToJudge.ruling: Nonblocking scale limit. Publish9.6MBextra CPU arrays per activated100kL1belt, lazy allocation and reuse; no total-scene memory claim.
declinedToJudge.costIfWrong: Many active belts can add substantial RAM pressure and cause pauses or allocation failure.

declinedToJudge.behavior: Physical WebGL context loss/restoration specifically after L1 compaction
declinedToJudge.reason: Code/lifecycle tests and GPU readiness transition cover integration, but new GPU fixture does not force the entire physical sequence.
declinedToJudge.ruling: Nonblocking unexecuted integration scenario. Canonical source restoration and unchanged renderer-owned buffers are supported by inspection/tests; explicitly distinguish this from a forced native context-loss proof.
declinedToJudge.costIfWrong: A restoration-only buffer or lifecycle defect could appear as missing instances after context recovery.

declinedToJudge.behavior: Oversized nonstandard custom shapes published after visibility selection, or unrestricted external mid-frame uniform mutation
declinedToJudge.reason: Engine pumps atlas work after updateView; documented real shape format normalizes maximum radius to1. Nonstandard inputs/mutation timing not established.
declinedToJudge.ruling: Nonblocking input/timing limit. Supported normalized cloud assets and ordinary updates are covered; do not certify assets violating the documented format or external mid-frame mutation. No shader/asset contract changed.
declinedToJudge.costIfWrong: A shape growing beyond the selected bound during that interval could be omitted at an image edge for a frame.

declinedToJudge.behavior: Universal bitwise identity across drivers and numerical extremes
declinedToJudge.reason: Conservative mathematical bound plus native/software fixtures cannot certify every floating-point implementation.
declinedToJudge.ruling: Nonblocking numerical/platform limit. Claim exact HDR/depth only for the recorded fixtures and production views; retain conservative margins and no universal guarantee.
declinedToJudge.costIfWrong: Extreme transforms or another driver's precision could expose boundary differences outside the tested range.

executionRulings.decision: Keep existing L0/Near loop verbatim; factor frustum/commit and add a separate atlas loop.
executionRulings.reason: Preserves established geometry arithmetic and avoids a per-slot mode branch.
executionRulings.costIfWrong: Shared storage/commit regression could affect multiple tiers; unchanged-loop verification plus mixed-tier unit/GPU tests passed.

executionRulings.decision: Retain the measured optimization with explicit CPU/RAM tradeoff.
executionRulings.reason: Repeatable isolated GPU reduction on the observed GPU-heavy scenes; motion cost and whole-frame measurement limits disclosed.
executionRulings.costIfWrong: CPU-limited or memory-constrained scenes could regress; broader benefit is not claimed.

executionRulings.decision: Use an equivalent staged working diff for the one fresh review before commit.
executionRulings.reason: Stock review-package requires an existing nonempty commit range; standing workflow calls for review before local commit. All new files included and evidence verified separately.
executionRulings.costIfWrong: An omitted staged file could escape review; explicit11-file manifest and staged checks confirm coverage.
